description: This PHP source file defines the SimpleSqlSearchEngine class, a naive search engine implementation for SuiteCRM that performs database searches using LIKE queries on table structures. It includes methods for searching modules, filtering table fields, and constructing SQL queries.

classes.name: SimpleSqlSearchEngine
classes.description: A naive search engine class that performs SQL LIKE searches on module tables within SuiteCRM.

methods.name: search
methods.description: Performs a search across modules and returns SearchResults with timing.

methods.name: filterTableStructure
methods.description: Filters table fields to include only varchar and text types for searching.

methods.name: getTableStructure
methods.description: Retrieves table structure as a name->type array using DBManager.

methods.name: validateQuery
methods.description: Validates and converts encoding of the search query.

methods.name: searchModule
methods.description: Performs search on a single module's table and returns matching record IDs.

methods.name: makeSearchQuery
methods.description: Constructs the SQL query string for searching.
